description: Prepare an editable, free calendar draft and a VenuNite preview link from interests, a fixed area, weekdays, time windows and exclusions. The tool performs no event search, geocoding, calendar save or subscription. The returned browser page provides the exact next-30-days preview and user-confirmed saving and calendar-app selection. Draft links contain preferences and the chosen location. Hosted calls record private request quota and telemetry; calendar apps control refresh timing.

audience.description: Account hide-family preferences always apply when the user saves.

interests.description: An event matches any one interest; conditions within an interest are combined. Keywords match event titles; jazz and trivia also match programming details.

days.description: Venue-local weekdays: Sunday=0 through Saturday=6. Omit for all days.

from.description: Venue-local start window HH:mm. Supply both from and to, or neither.

keyword.description: Keyword or phrase. Empty with an empty category means all event types.

to.description: Exclusive end of start window HH:mm, later than from. Overnight windows need separate interests.

location.description: An exact center explicitly chosen by the user. Never invent coordinates; omit if unknown.

place.description: A city and state or ZIP, for example Boulder, CO or 80302. The user confirms the center in the browser. Omit if unknown.

radius_miles.description: Fixed subscription radius, 1–50 miles. Default is 10; tell the user the radius.

name: create_calendar_draft
title: Draft an interest calendar
